measure: the rating (Hold / Buy / Avoid) for every window in history.csv, from README's rules

rules.avoid: this window and the one ending 30 days earlier fail, or the drain test fails
rules.avoid_drain: the buybacks stock (history.csv buybacks_end) at the window's end is more than drain_max below its highest window end since 2026-11-01: Avoid at once, until it is back within drain_max of that peak
rules.buy: rule (b) read from the chain (a declared lock that cannot send NEAR out: no contract and no keys, or code whose hash was reviewed and listed, and no full-access key), treasury.near quiet in the window (same multisig request nonce at both ends, no full-access key), and coverage counted (kept, at most DefiLlama's revenue and fees) >= 100% or (a) at a yearly check
rules.avoid_test_1: not judged if DefiLlama's revenue is zero or a day is missing; test 2 (read from the chain, with the window's mean price) then decides alone
rules.avoid_test_2_private_path: not judged if DefiLlama's fees fell too (or are missing) and the Confidential Intents Treasury account's stablecoins grew over the window; not read counts as not grown
